registration.primary_endpoint: on the target categories, runs with empty memory: the smaller of the mean change in the acquired score and the mean change in gain (means over seeds within a category, then over categories) between the final version of the self lineage and the generation-0 version; claimed only if it is at least 0.01 and its 95% bootstrap interval, resampling categories and seeds, excludes zero
registration.recursion_test: rounds >= 2: nominees found from the self lineage's version by the self version, by generation 0 and by the random proposer, at equal search CPU, compared on source-pool improvement and on the gate; with one such round this can refute but cannot establish that the improved improver matters

revisions.what: the improvement of a version over another is the smaller of the two MEAN changes (acquired, gain), not the mean of per-run minima: a development round on the source categories showed that the mean of minima is pulled below zero by seed noise alone, which made neutral changes look harmful. This matches the wording of the rule ('improve acquired and gain by this much, on average'). No number was changed.

fixes required by the independent audit of the seven adapters and of the kernel, none of them a registered number: bin packing keeps only problems that share no stretch of the one stream its files are cut from; quadratic assignment is scored by the share of the way from a random permutation to the published value (threshold 0.90); the deciding and confirming halves of the fresh instances are whole published groups; every instance has its own relabelling; a malformed answer scores 0 and is never repaired; assignment is metered; the learner receives a generic view of a problem; two physical laws with a degenerate or repeated reference are left out; the forecasting threshold is taken over the series scored; anchors of thresholds are worded as what they are (most are operating points, not external facts).

registration.rounds_note: the draw provides three adoption sets; two rounds are run because of the time and usage limits of the session, and the third set stays unused and sealed; the number was fixed here, before any round
registration.thresholds_note: the thresholds of job shop, bin packing, quadratic assignment, p-median and knapsack are operating points chosen before any run, not external facts; prediction R7 depends on them and is scored as registered, with this caveat
registration.what: RSI-6: registered numbers for the rounds of self-modification and the test on the sealed target categories

what: the target test is postponed and the targets stay sealed until the continued improvement process is frozen; the third adoption set becomes that process's gate and its adapters are built now

the continued process is registered: second design of the learner as generation 0, breadth as the search objective, round b1 gated on the third adoption set, a conditional round b2 gated on two reserves, a target test that covers both processes

registration.design_comparison: b:frozen minus frozen, and b:frozen minus compute@b, on the targets. Reported as what it is: a comparison of two designs written by the experimenter, at equal counted units and at equal measured CPU
failure_conditions: no version adopted by the self lineage: no generation exists to compare, and the result is 'no modification passed independent validation'
primary endpoint below 0.01 or interval including zero: 'no improvement of acquisition on unseen categories established'
self nominees not better than the random proposer's: 'the mechanism does not acquire the capability of improving itself'
any comparison in which the control received less measured CPU than the arm it is compared with is void

2.note: the first two reserves of the draw's order become the gate of round b2 if it is run; one reserve (genassign) remains for the targets. Their adapters are built and audited only if round b2 is run

generation_0.development: on the source pool only, as it stood after the two rounds (five assignment categories: bin packing, job shop, quadratic assignment, p-median, knapsack; the prediction form was not changed). No run on any category of the third adoption set, a target or a reserve. Its defaults plan.min_tests and plan.batch were chosen by comparing variants on those five categories with seeds 11 to 16 of the search budget

development_numbers.reading: at equal counted units the second design is ahead by 0.019 (better in four categories, worse in none); it spends about 2.5 times the CPU, and at equal measured CPU the two designs are level on the mean (the first design at 2 to 4 times its budget), with different profiles: the second ahead on job shop, p-median and knapsack, the first ahead on quadratic assignment

variants_compared_for_the_defaults.note: mean change of the acquired score against the first design at the registered budget; the chosen one was better in four categories and worse in none

development_numbers.what: development comparison on the five assignment categories of the source pool, fresh instances of the search budget (12 training instances, the deciding half), seeds 11 to 16; scratch runs, not in the ledger

generation_0.rule: after this record a change to the files of the second design is a recorded correction needed for the contract; a change made to raise a score is not allowed
generation_0.written_by: the experimenter, after reading the records of the two rounds. It is not a product of the system's self-modification, and its comparison with the first design is not a test of recursion

registration.lineages: self (the improver is the lineage's newest version), fixed (the improver is generation 0 of the second design), random (random single-field changes); from round b2 also fixed@self and random@self
not_claimed: that the second design's advantage over the first is a result of self-modification: it was written by the experimenter

open-endedness: the descriptors the second design can build are compositions of the descriptors it starts with (products, a product with progress, squares); the fields of a version are a list written by the experimenter
anything about prediction-form categories: no unseen category of that form is left, and the prediction form was not changed

predictions.text: round b1: the self search finds a candidate that counts as an improvement of the source pool

predictions.criterion: gate.adopted is false, or there is no nominee
predictions.text: round b1: the self nominee is not adopted

predictions.criterion: correlation between the two seeds of the improvement over its candidates is at least 0.3
predictions.text: the self search ranks candidates more reliably than noise

predictions.criterion: b:frozen minus frozen: mean change of the acquired score above 0
predictions.text: on the targets the second design at generation 0 acquires more than the first design at generation 0, at equal counted units

predictions.criterion: b:frozen minus compute@b: the 95% interval of the change of the acquired score includes zero or lies below it
predictions.text: at equal measured CPU that advantage is not established

predictions.criterion: b:skills minus b:frozen: mean change of the acquired score below 0.005
predictions.text: memory of earlier categories does not help the second design on unseen categories

predictions.criterion: no adoption by b:self, or the smaller mean change below 0.01, or an interval that includes zero
predictions.text: the primary endpoint of this process is not met

registration.primary_endpoint: on the target categories, runs with empty memory: the smaller of the mean change in the acquired score and the mean change in gain (means over seeds within a category, then over categories) between the final version of the b:self lineage and generation 0 of the second design; claimed only if it is at least 0.01 and its 95% bootstrap interval, resampling categories and seeds, excludes zero. If the b:self lineage adopts nothing there is nothing to compare and nothing is claimed
registration.search_cpu_note: a candidate is measured on seven categories instead of three to five, and a run of the second design costs more CPU; the limit is raised so that a search can measure about as many candidates as before
registration.search_objective: rounds.breadth: the change in each source category is cut to [-0.03, +0.01] before the mean over categories is taken, for the acquired score and for the gain; the smaller of the two means. A nominee is the best candidate with a positive value. The gate, the confirmation and the adoption rule are those of the two registered rounds, on the uncut changes
registration.second_round_rule: round b2 is run only if the self lineage adopted a version in round b1; from an unchanged version it would repeat round b1
registration.seeds_note: the searches use seeds that the development of the second design did not use
registration.target_test: one run of targets.py after this process is frozen: the eight arms registered for the two rounds (first design), the same eight for this process (prefix b:), and compute@b (generation 0 of the first design with its training budget raised to the measured CPU of this process's primary arm plus an equal share of what this process spent on its rounds)
registration.what: amendment 2: the continued process. Rounds of self-modification of the second design of the learner, on the same ledger, kernel, gate rule and sealed targets as the two registered rounds
registration.why: the two registered rounds adopted nothing (amendment 1): generation 0 of the first design got one to three rounds of learning at the registered budget and gained nothing on four of seven categories, and what its improver found was carried by one category and failed the gate

why: the self lineage adopted no version in the round before; the registered rule is to stop

what: generation 0 of both designs on the released gate categories of round b1, same budgets and seeds as the gate and the confirmation; not registered
process c is registered: four techniques of self-modification in turn, provisional adoption on set-aside pool categories, success decided afterwards on the reserves and the sealed targets

registration.adoption_rule: a nominee is adopted if it passes the registered gate on the three categories set aside (margin, interval, CPU ratio; deciding half of their fresh instances) and its confirmation (other half, other seeds) is above zero; if several pass, the one with the largest value at the gate. Versions above search_cpu_ratio times the CPU of the current version on the searched categories are not nominated

decision.external_gate: after the last generation the final version is put through the registered gate against generation 0 on the reserve categories tour and colouring (role adoption:4, adapters built and audited by independent agents, no learner run on them before), seeds 4001 to 4006, confirmation 5001 to 5006
decision.success: recursive self-improvement is reported as observed only if (1) at least two generations adopted a version, (2) the final version passes the external gate, and (3) on the sealed targets the smaller of the mean changes of the acquired score and of the gain between the final version and generation 0 is at least 0.01 with a 95% bootstrap interval that excludes zero, and the final version is not behind the compute-matched arm. Anything less is reported as what it is
decision.targets: then one run of the target test for all three processes; arms of process c: c:frozen is generation 0 of the first design (the registered arm 'frozen'), c:self the final version, c:skills, c:memory, c:compute and c:search as registered for the other processes

registration.design_note: generation 0 is the first design of the learner (frozen, hashes below). The second design showed no advantage on the two categories neither design was developed on (post hoc runs, recorded) and costs 1.3 to 3.8 times the CPU
registration.kinds_note: light: generation 0 learns on them and a run is cheap. heavy: generation 0 learns on them and a run costs one to several CPU-minutes. still: generation 0 gained nothing on them in any recorded run (gain 0.0000, 0.0000 and +0.0016); they are not searched on and stay in the gates, one per generation, as a check that a nominee harms nothing there
not_claimed: that an adoption inside this process is evidence of improvement on unseen categories
open-endedness: the versions are points of a list of 38 fields written by the experimenter
that the techniques are the system's own invention: they were written by the experimenter; what the system does is measure, select and adopt

predictions.criterion: count of adopt records of process c >= 1
predictions.text: at least one version is adopted provisionally within six generations

predictions.criterion: adoptions by single, remeasure or combine > adoptions by climb
predictions.text: single-field techniques are adopted more often than the climb

predictions.criterion: no adoption, or external gate not passed
predictions.text: the final version does not pass the external gate

predictions.criterion: one of the three parts of the success condition fails
predictions.text: the success condition is not met

registration.provisional: the categories set aside belong to the pool: across generations each is searched on and set aside in turn, and every generation tests up to four nominees. An adoption here is therefore provisional and may be an effect of repeated testing. Nothing is claimed from it
registration.seeds_rule: generation g: search 1000+10g+1 and +2; re-measurement +3 and +4; gate 2000+10g+1 to +6; confirmation 3000+10g+1 to +6
registration.split_rule: each of the three lists is ordered by SHA-256 of 'rsi6 process c|<name>'; generation g sets aside the light category at position (g-1) mod 4, the heavy one at (g-1) mod 2 and the still one at (g-1) mod 3; it searches on the three other light categories and the other heavy one

techniques.climb: the learner's own search over versions (as in the earlier rounds) on the three light categories, improver and start the current version, objective breadth, within climb_cpu_limit
techniques.combine: of those, the changes with positive breadth that improved at least one searched category by more than 0.005 and lowered none by more than 0.005 are tried in order of breadth, at most eight, one per field; a change is added if the measured breadth of the combination on the four categories rises by more than 0.001
techniques.remeasure: the five best of those with positive breadth are measured with two more seeds on the four categories; the nominee is the best by breadth over the four seeds, if positive
techniques.single: every single-field change of the current version (the grid of its design) is measured with two seeds on the three light categories searched on; the twelve best by breadth there, if positive, are measured on the heavy category searched on as well; the nominee is the best by breadth over the four categories, if positive

registration.what: amendment 3: process c. Several techniques of self-modification tried in turn, generation after generation, each judged on categories of the pool that its search did not see
registration.why: the Owner's instruction 9 (try several techniques in turn until success), after three rounds with six nominees and no adoption; the two nominees that came closest were single-field changes, and what the improvers found by following their measurements on the pool lost on new categories
